summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the new 'Emploi' module. Backend pytest 4/4 pass (CRUD, auth guards, required-field validation). Admin UI flow fully validated end-to-end via Playwright: dashboard shortcut card visible, form validation (empty title returns 'Le titre est obligatoire.'), publish a job (title/description/contact/country/salary), edit persists, toggle active/inactive updates the ACTIVE|INACTIVE badge, delete removes the card. User-facing surfaces (BottomNav + (app)/emploi + Plus menu) verified at code level (see notes in action_items) — behavioural test with a non-admin user was skipped because no activated test user is seeded and admins bypass the user BottomNav.
action_items: OPTIONAL: Consider adding an integration test using a seeded non-admin activated user to visually confirm the bottom-nav 'Emploi' entry + Plus-menu changes. Current verification was code-level (BottomNav.tsx LEFT array + PLUS_MENU: 'emploi' present, 'devis'/'request' removed).

NON-BLOCKING: /emploi route returned 'Unmatched Route' on the FIRST browser hit right after backend restart; a `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` fixed it (Metro bundle was stale). Main agent should be aware that hot-reload of a newly-created group route (`(app)/emploi.tsx` + `(admin)/emploi.tsx` with the same URL segment) can require a Metro rebuild — production build will not have this issue.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/jobs.py: JobIn.country validator only strips + range-checks length (min 2 / max 3) but does NOT validate that the code is a real ISO alpha-2/3 code. Minor — front-end restricts choice to /config countries, but a malicious admin could POST 'ZZ'. Consider validating against a whitelist.
backend/jobs.py::list_jobs (public GET /api/jobs) reads with limit 500 — fine for now, but add pagination + text search once >200 offers are expected.

(app)/emploi.tsx: `if (typeof window !== 'undefined') window.alert(...)` is used as a fallback for contact — on native mobile the user would silently see nothing when contactHref returns null. Acceptable for MVP.
(admin)/emploi.tsx: no client-side confirm before Toggle (only Delete) — intended UX-wise. OK.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for admin UI CRUD flow (create/toggle/edit/delete + validation)

seed_data_creation: None persisted — every job created during testing (TEST_Job_Playwright x2 leftover from previous partial runs + TEST_Job_UI_Flow) was deleted via the UI delete action; final state = 0 offres.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is production-ready from backend + admin side. If further verification is required for the user-side BottomNav, register a new user (any referrer OK, admin is fine as parent), login as that user (they land on user dashboard where BottomNav renders), and verify: [data-testid=bottom-nav-emploi] present with label 'Emploi' + briefcase icon, [data-testid=bottom-nav-more] click opens sheet with [data-testid=bottom-nav-plus-emploi] and NO 'Demande de service' entry. Also verify /(app)/emploi renders job description in full (no 'voir plus') and image tap opens MediaLightbox.
